tool.name: TrainModel
tool.description: Trains a PyTorch autoencoder using the given properties.

param.name: input_model_pth_path
param.help: Path to the input model file

param.name: input_dataset_pt_path
param.help: Path to the input dataset file (.pt) produced by the MD feature pipeline

param.name: outname_output_model_pth_path
param.help: Path to save the trained model (.pth). If omitted, the trained model is only available in memory

param.name: outname_output_metrics_npz_path
param.help: Path save training metrics in compressed NumPy format (.npz)

param.name: config_json
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax
